Based on my search through the codebase, I found the implementation of the stale-while-revalidate caching pattern:

`src/Illuminate/Cache/Repository.php`

The `flexible()` method implements this pattern. It uses two TTL values: a grace period (ttl[0]) where fresh values are served, and a maximum age (ttl[1]) beyond which stale values can still be served while a background refresh is deferred. When a value becomes stale but is still within the max age window, the cached stale value is returned immediately, and a background refresh is deferred using a cache lock to prevent concurrent refreshes.
